title: WBOS Bedrock Tool Registry
description: Amazon Bedrock Foundation Model Tool Specifications for WBOS v2

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Lookup an existing customer profile by their international E.164 phone number.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Register a new customer profile with their phone number, full name, and delivery address.

address.description: Customer delivery street address or landmark

latitude.description: Optional GPS latitude if provided via WhatsApp location pin

longitude.description: Optional GPS longitude if provided via WhatsApp location pin

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description: Update an existing customer's delivery address or profile information.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the live product catalog using keyword matching or category filtering.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. 'basmati rice', 'amul milk', 'fortune oil'

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return

tools.name: check_inventory
tools.description: Check current stock availability, units, and price for a list of specific product IDs.

tools.name: get_low_stock_products
tools.description: Retrieve all inventory items that have fallen below their configured reorder threshold.

thresholdOverride.description: Optional custom threshold value to filter by instead of product default

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a new customer order. Validates stock, calculates 5% GST and delivery fees, reserves inventory, and transitions order to PENDING.

customerId.description: ID of the customer placing the order

deliveryAddress.description: Delivery address for this specific order

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Fetch complete status, line items, breakdown, and rider info for a specific order ID.

tools.name: get_customer_orders
tools.description: Fetch the order history and current active orders for a customer.

limit.description: Number of recent orders to fetch

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order if it is in DRAFT, PENDING, or CONFIRMED state. Restores reserved inventory.

tools.name: get_daily_sales
tools.description: Business Owner Tool: Aggregate gross revenue, order count, and average order value for a specific calendar date.

date.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if omitted.

tools.name: get_pending_orders
tools.description: Business Owner Tool: List all orders currently awaiting review, packing, or dispatch.

tools.name: get_sales_summary
tools.description: Business Owner Tool: Generate multi-day sales performance metrics and top-selling product breakdown.

tools.name: update_order_status
tools.description: Operations Tool: Advance an order through its formal state machine (e.g. CONFIRMED -> PREPARING -> READY).

packerName.description: Staff member name when transitioning to PREPARING/READY

tools.name: assign_delivery
tools.description: Operations Tool: Assign a delivery rider to a READY order, generating a live tracking link.
